title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
summary: OpenAI 通过 Basis、Clay 和 Exa Labs 的案例，展示了 AI 原生企业如何利用 AI 代理优化入职、客户管理和开发者集成，并提炼出企业领导者可借鉴的工作流转化为运营能力的方法。
highlights: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations.
See what enterprise leaders can apply.
